authorityClaim: This artifact NAMES initial states for the live G29 v2 excluded-form and substitution-mutation corpora, drawn from G29 v2 exactByteIntent. It does not author fixture bytes. It does not invent a section 7.1 recipe. It does not take over G21, G23, G24, or G30. It does not SATISFY DR-117. It does not reopen leftover-design of EE-1, EE-2, EE-3b, EE-4, EE-5a, EE-5b, or EE-6a. It does not execute G29. It does not close leftover-design of G29 fixture implementations. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
